component.name: OnChangeScene
component.script:
sub init() m.reports = 0 m.task = createObject("roSGNode", "OnChangeTask") m.task.observeField("ready", "onReady") m.task.observeField("report", "onReport") m.task.control = "run" m.timer = createObject("roSGNode", "Timer") m.timer.duration = 0.3 m.timer.observeField("fire", "onRerun") end sub
sub onReady() m.task.cmd = 1 m.task.fromRender = 5 end sub
' Re-run once the first run has returned. sub onRerun() m.task.control = "run" end sub
sub onReport(event as object) m.reports++ print "TASK SAW: " + event.getData() if m.reports = 1 m.timer.control = "start" else m.global.finished = true end if end sub
